maps.title: Step 1a Role Selection
maps.role: User selects or searches for a role before entering posting evidence.
maps.handoff: Feeds a role title/query into Step 2.

implementationCommit.role: Published Step 1a map and mobile layout source on main.

deploymentStatus.notes: The Step 2 feature-map branch does not change Step 1a deployment state.

physicalRuntimeVerification.notes: Step 1a screenshots and browser evidence remain in its published map; this index does not add a new physical device pass.

maps.title: Step 2 Posting Evidence Picker
maps.role: User compares live source postings and selects one evidence-bearing job ad.
maps.handoff: Derives a reduced Step 3 posting view and a separate source-bearing analysis request from the selected posting.

implementationCommit.role: Audited Step 2, careers.gov.sg handoff and Business Cube implementation verified by local contracts and Chromium fixtures.

mergeCommit.notes: This feature-map revision describes an implementation commit on an unmerged follow-up branch.

deploymentStatus.notes: No Vercel, Railway or production deployment is claimed for this implementation commit.

physicalRuntimeVerification.notes: Deterministic Chromium fixtures cover the mapped paths; no physical-device production verification is claimed.

maps.title: Step 3 Work Universe
maps.role: Work Universe, evidence workspace and review-output map after a selected posting or role run.
maps.handoff: Receives a Step 1a role query or the reduced Step 3 posting view produced from a Step 2 selection.

implementationCommit.role: Audited Step 2, careers.gov.sg handoff and Business Cube implementation verified by local contracts and Chromium fixtures.

mergeCommit.notes: This feature-map revision describes an implementation commit on an unmerged follow-up branch.

deploymentStatus.notes: No Vercel, Railway or production deployment is claimed for this implementation commit.

physicalRuntimeVerification.notes: Deterministic Chromium fixtures cover the mapped paths; no physical-device production verification is claimed.

connections.contract: Step 1a provides the role title/query; Step 2 must not convert SSOC suggestion state into a source-posting prefilter.
Step 2 carries selected source, identifiers, employer and duty text into Step 3; careers.gov.sg-only evidence can seed organisation AI Moments and remains explicitly withheld when thin.

contracts.statement: Every map entry separates implementation commit, merge commit, deployment status and physical-runtime verification.
Feature-map work must preserve v3/ and Railway configuration unless explicitly requested otherwise.
